recognize_zh: TCR-βF1染色下，皮下脂肪與真皮間的淋巴樣浸潤中有一部分細胞呈棕色陽性（αβ型T細胞），另有相當比例細胞為陰性；陽性提示浸潤至少部分為αβ T細胞，陰性者可能為γδ T或NK細胞，HV-LPD可以是T或NK細胞型，需搭配CD56、TCRγ與EBER判讀。
features: TCR-beta-F1 positivity in a subset of lymphoid cells within the subcutaneous and deep dermal infiltrate
Positive cells are small to medium-sized with membranous and cytoplasmic staining, some with fine dendritic-like processes
A substantial proportion of infiltrating cells is negative
Adipocytes and stromal cells negative; positive cells distributed interstitially and between fat cells
describe_en: TCR-beta-F1 immunohistochemistry on the subcutaneous and deep dermal lymphoid infiltrate shows staining of a subset of small to medium-sized lymphocytes distributed interstitially and between adipocytes, while a substantial proportion of the infiltrate is negative. This indicates that at least part of the infiltrate consists of alpha-beta T cells, and the negative cells may represent NK cells or gamma-delta T cells. Hydroa vacciniforme lymphoproliferative disorder may be of cytotoxic T-cell (alpha-beta or gamma-delta) or NK-cell lineage, so this stain should be interpreted with CD56, TCR-gamma, cytotoxic markers and EBER.

ddx.vs: Gamma-delta TCL is uniformly TCR-beta-F1-negative and TCR-gamma-positive, EBER-negative, whereas this infiltrate contains a beta-F1-positive subset.
SPTCL is diffusely beta-F1-positive and CD8-positive with adipocyte rimming and EBER negativity.
ENKTL of NK type is beta-F1-negative and CD56-positive with angiodestruction, necrosis and EBER positivity.
